items.statement: Within the defined EcCLC model, proton-pathway water facilitates chloride transport by reducing the free-energy barriers from S_cen toward both neighboring sites.
items.expected: The submitted barrier comparison supports lower chain-A barriers in both directions and states model/sampling limitations.
